description: turn: keeps each of turn's agents running until its own record shows it did its job, and stops what it must not do when it tries it

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/subagentstop.py"; fi
